job.title: Technical Delivery Manager (Banking)
job.description:
Technical Delivery Manager/Project Manager

As an experienced Technical Delivery Manager/Project Manager, you'll be at the heart of project delivery, working closely with various business departments. This role involves end to end hands-on project management from capturing requirements to post-delivery support.

job.title: Infrastructure engineer (MSP)

  • Strong practical knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Teams, and Microsoft 365 tenant configuration.

job.title: Date Engineer (Palantir)
job.description:
Date Engineer with Data Migration , Pipeline Migration & Palantir
Location: Leeds, UK or Reading, UK
Travel Requirements: Mostly Remote - Travel to offices as required

About the Role:

Data Engineer with Data Migration , Pipeline Migration & Palantir

Build and improve the data pipelines that turn healthcare information into reliable measures, reports and published outputs. Positions cover metric calculation, governed data stores, reporting datasets and analytical pipeline migration. Some positions also develop the applications used to review and approve data.

Responsibilities
• Develop reusable transformations and data models, with clear definitions, identifiers, reporting periods and version information.
• Implement validation, merge and correction rules, reliable refresh, and safe recovery or reruns after a failure.

• Data applications: where assigned, proven application delivery is required for review and approval workflows, permissions and audit history using the selected Foundry or custom application approach.

job.title: Data Architect (Specialty Insurance)
job.description:
Data Architect – Specialty Insurance


Contract: 6 months initial
Rate: Up to £650 per day
IR35: Inside IR35
Working Model: Hybrid, initially 2 days per week in the office

The Role


We are looking for an experienced Data Architect to take end-to-end ownership of the data architecture for a major cloud data platform within the specialty insurance market.
This is a senior, hands-on architecture position responsible for defining the target-state data architecture, modelling approach, integration patterns, migration strategy and governance standards across the platform.
You will be expected to set the architectural standards rather than simply work within an existing framework. You will act as the key authority when decisions around data modelling, platform design or integration are challenged, while remaining technically hands-on with Snowflake and SQL.
The successful candidate must combine strong architecture capabilities with current or very recent experience within London Market insurance, Lloyd's, MGA or reinsurance environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end data architecture for a cloud-based data platform.
  • Define and maintain target-state data models and architectural standards.
  • Lead the implementation and evolution of Data Vault 2.0 within Snowflake.
  • Architect dimensional and consumption layers sitting above the Data Vault.
  • Define integration patterns across source systems, the data platform and downstream consumers.
  • Own the architectural approach to data migration from legacy environments into the cloud platform.
  • Establish standards covering data governance, classification, retention and regulatory compliance.
  • Provide architectural leadership and resolve contested modelling and platform-design decisions.
  • Work directly with stakeholders across underwriting, claims, finance and wider business functions to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.
  • Remain hands-on where required, particularly across Snowflake, SQL and data modelling.
  • Ensure the architecture is scalable, governed and aligned with the long-term technology strategy.

Essential Experience


Candidates must demonstrate:

  • Current or very recent specialty insurance experience, ideally within the London Market, Lloyd's syndicates, MGAs or reinsurance.
  • Proven experience designing, implementing and operating Data Vault 2.0 within Snowflake.
  • Strong experience designing the dimensional / consumption layer on top of a Data Vault architecture.
  • Experience taking a cloud data platform from initial design through migration and implementation, rather than solely maintaining an established platform.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Snowflake and SQL.
  • Experience defining data architecture and modelling standards at enterprise or platform level.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, classification, retention and GDPR within a regulated environment.
  • Ability to engage directly with senior business stakeholders and challenge requirements where appropriate.
  • Experience translating requirements from functions such as underwriting, claims and finance into data architecture and platform decisions.

Desirable Experience


Exposure to some of the following would be advantageous:

  • dbt
  • Fivetran
  • Kafka
  • AWS
  • Data catalogue and governance tooling
  • Master Data Management (MDM)

Candidate Profile


This role would suit an established Data Architect who is comfortable being the technical authority for data architecture within a complex transformation programme.
You should be equally comfortable discussing requirements with an underwriting or finance stakeholder as you are challenging a technical team on the correct Data Vault modelling or integration approach.
This is not purely a high-level architecture role. The successful candidate will need to maintain enough hands-on capability to work effectively within Snowflake and SQL and provide technical direction based on practical experience.

job.title: Boomi Integration Architect

.

Boomi Solution Architect | Integration & API Platform Programme


We are seeking an experienced Boomi Solution Architect to support the adoption and evolution of a strategic enterprise integration platform within a large-scale government environment.
This is a client-side architecture role requiring a strong blend of technical expertise, integration architecture leadership, governance, and stakeholder engagement. You will be responsible for driving the adoption of strategic integration capabilities across multiple programmes, ensuring solutions align with enterprise architecture standards and avoid the proliferation of point-to-point integrations.
The successful candidate will possess deep expertise across Boomi iPaaS, API Management, Event Streaming, Integration Architecture, and Enterprise Governance, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Integration Architecture & Project Onboarding

Technical Leadership

Governance & Assurance

Platform Roadmap & Continuous Improvement

Data Sharing Solution Design

  • Produce end-to-end solution designs covering:
    • Data flows

job.title: Senior Security & Cyber Operations Manager (Financial Services)
job.description:
Role: Senior Security and Cyber Operations Manager
Location: Corporate Offices / Hybrid (UK)
Industry: Financial Services / Insurance (Regulated Environment)
Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Senior Security & Cyber Operations Manager | Operations, Incident Response & AI Innovation

  • End-to-end operational ownership of enterprise security operations (SOC), incident response, threat detection, and cyber defence capabilities.
  • Drive detection engineering, SOAR automation, and AI integration across cloud, hybrid infrastructure, endpoints, and third-party services.
  • Key focus: Incident leadership, MSSP/vendor management, response playbooks, metrics (MTTD/MTTR), and executive risk governance.

About the Opportunity
A leading UK financial services organisation is seeking a high-performing Senior Security and Cyber Operations Manager to lead, mature, and optimize its end-to-end security operations and cyber defence ecosystem.
Reporting directly to the CISO, you will act as the organizational subject matter expert for incident response, threat monitoring, and operational cyber risk. In this hands-on leadership role, you will bridge the gap between real-time threat telemetry and executive risk decision-making—ensuring security events are rapidly detected, contained, remediated, and learned from. You will also lead the vendor management of external MSSP partners while leveraging AI, SOAR, and intelligent data enrichment to build a modern, high-velocity SOC function.
Key Accountabilities

  • End-to-End Cyber Defence Ownership: Lead the complete operational lifecycle across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, NDR, and identity telemetry—covering monitoring, alert triage, incident containment, root-cause eradication, and post-incident learning.
  • Major Incident Response & Crisis Leadership: Act as the operational escalation point during major security events; lead crisis containment strategies, evidence collection, regulatory reporting, and executive updates.
  • AI, SOAR & Continuous Improvement: Champion the practical application of AI, orchestration, and automated triage to reduce alert fatigue, minimize false positives, streamline investigations, and accelerate response playbooks.
  • Vendor & MSSP Governance: Own relationships with external managed security service providers (MSSPs), threat intelligence vendors, and incident response retainers, ensuring SLA compliance, delivery quality, and value alignment.
  • Cross-CIO Collaboration: Work across Engineering, Cloud, Data, and Architecture to embed threat detection models, logging standards, and incident playbooks directly into operational pipelines.
  • Governance & Executive Metrics: Define and maintain core performance metrics (MTTD, MTTR, telemetry health, alert fidelity) and deliver actionable reporting for CISO, Risk Committee, and Board discussions.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Enterprise Operations Leadership: Proven track record managing SOC, cyber defence, or incident response functions in complex, regulated environments (Financial Services/Insurance preferred).
  • Technical Depth in Security Tooling: In-depth knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, NDR, threat intelligence platforms, and telemetry architectures across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Incident Management Mastery: Demonstrable experience leading major security incidents, assessing severity, defining containment strategies, and executing post-incident root-cause remediation.
  • MSSP & Partner Management: Direct experience governing external managed security service providers and third-party incident response retainers.
  • AI & Automation Focus: Practical understanding of applying AI, machine learning, or SOAR playbooks to automate security workflows and enrich threat triage.
  • Executive Stakeholder Communication: Ability to translate complex technical cyber incidents into clear business risk impact and pragmatic recommendations for senior leadership.

job.title: Cyber Exposure & Vulnerability Manager
job.description:
Role: Senior Cyber Exposure & Vulnerability Manager
Location: Corporate Offices / Hybrid (UK)
Industry: Financial Services / Insurance (Regulated Environment)
Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Senior Cyber Exposure & Vulnerability Manager | Hands-On AI & Exposure Leader

  • End-to-end operational ownership of enterprise exposure, vulnerability management, and zero-day response capabilities.
  • Drive modern risk-based prioritisation and AI-driven automation across cloud, infrastructure, and application estates.
  • Key focus: Strategy execution, cross-CIO collaboration, backlog reduction, and executive-level governance.

About the Opportunity
A leading UK financial services organisation is looking for a high-performing Senior Cyber Exposure & Vulnerability Manager to own and evolve its end-to-end vulnerability management and response framework.
Reporting directly to the Deputy CISO, you will act as the organizational authority on exposure management. In this hands-on, high-impact role, you will bridge the gap between technical risk and business reality—ensuring vulnerabilities across infrastructure, cloud, and applications are identified, prioritised, remediated, and reported in a disciplined, risk-based manner. Additionally, you will champion the practical application of AI and intelligent automation to modernise triage, threat correlation, and remediation workflows.
Key Accountabilities

  • End-to-End Vulnerability Ownership: Own the enterprise lifecycle across infrastructure, cloud, apps, and third-party services—covering scanning, triage, risk prioritisation, mitigation, and verification.
  • Hands-On Delivery & Response: Manage vulnerability backlogs, ageing, high/critical remediation activity, scan coverage, and emergency response to zero-day exposures.
  • AI, Automation & Innovation: Champion the practical use of AI and data-driven insights to optimise triage, reduce false positives, perform root-cause clustering, and automate reporting.
  • Cross-CIO Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Cloud, Data, and Architecture teams to embed vulnerability response into existing delivery pipelines rather than treating it as a parallel task.
  • Governance & Executive Reporting: Define and track KPIs/KRIs (SLAs, exposure trends, backlog health) and deliver concise, actionable reporting for CIO leadership, Audit, and CISO/Board forums.
  • Risk & Regulatory Support: Align exposure decisions to organizational risk appetite, manage formal risk acceptances, and drive audit and regulatory remediation actions to closure.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Enterprise Exposure Experience: Proven track record running vulnerability management and response within complex, highly regulated environments (Financial Services/Insurance preferred).
  • Technical Breadth: Strong hands-on understanding of vulnerability management principles, tooling, and remediation across cloud, hybrid infrastructure, applications, and platforms.
  • Risk-Based Prioritisation: Expertise in context-aware risk scoring (combining CVSS, threat intelligence, asset criticality, attack surface, and business impact).
  • Forward-Looking Mindset: Genuine interest and practical experience in leveraging AI, machine learning, or automated tooling to streamline cyber operations.
  • Influence & Stakeholder Management: Ability to translate complex technical vulnerabilities into clear business risk and drive remediation across engineering teams without relying on formal authority.

To Apply
If you are an energetic, delivery-focused vulnerability leader looking to drive modern, AI-enabled exposure management within a fast-paced environment, please submit your CV for immediate consideration.

job.title: Cyber Essentials Project Engineer

job.title: Solutions Architect-Ncino
job.description:
Solutions Architect - Unified Lending Transformation

Location: London or Manchester (Hybrid)

Duration: Initial 12-Month Contract (Likely Extension)

Start Date: October 2026

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Arhcitect to lead a major lending transformation discovery and architecture engagement for a leading UK financial services organisation.

The organisation is undertaking a strategic initiative to exit its existing lending platforms and define the future-state architecture for its Business Banking lending capabilities. The successful candidate will play a critical leadership role in shaping the target technology landscape, providing architectural direction, and leading delivery teams through a complex transformation programme.

This is a high-profile role requiring a blend of consulting expertise, enterprise architecture leadership, stakeholder management, and lending technology experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technology workstream for a large-scale lending transformation programme.
  • Define and shape target-state architecture for Business Banking lending capabilities.
  • Provide strategic guidance on platform selection and transformation approach.
  • Assess existing lending technology estate and make recommendations regarding future architecture.
  • Engage closely with senior stakeholders across business and technology functions.
  • Lead discovery activities, architecture assessments, and technical roadmap creation.
  • Drive engineering best practices and architectural excellence across the programme.
  • Provide oversight and leadership to distributed and offshore delivery teams.
  • Ensure agile delivery practices are embedded throughout the engagement.
  • Support the transition from current lending platforms to the agreed target-state solution.
